description: Local HTTP server -> curl downloads payload -> chmod +x -> execute it
notes: Steps are the attacker-relevant ACTIONS in the script. 'syscall' and 'target' say which recorded event evidences the action. 'after' restricts matching to events later than another step's event (the script cleans its work directory at start, so earlier events on the same path must not match). 'causal' relationships must be explainable by walking parent_event/resource_event links backwards from the later event; 'order' relationships only need correct time order.

steps.action: curl connects to local HTTP server

relationships.why: same process: curl starts, then connects
same process: connection precedes saving the response
content written to the file just created
chmod changes the file curl produced (data dependency across processes)
same process: chmod starts then calls fchmodat
the file made executable is the one executed
